blocks.text: The Account Settings icon () on the Zscaler ITDR navigation menu enables you to manage your user profile and notification preferences.
Account Settings provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Customize user profile information such as name and time zone.
Change the password or reset the 2FA that you used to log in to the Zscaler ITDR Admin Portal.

blocks.text: On the Account Settings page, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Profile: Reset 2FA, edit your user profile, and change your password.
The Reset 2FA and Change Password actions are available only if the Disable Password Login option is selected while adding a user.
Notification Preferences: Customize your email notification preferences for information relating to the license and security alerts.
